phrases:back-east-us.title: back east
phrases:back-east-us.explanation: 从美国西部或中部的视角指美国东部；back 带有回望来处或既有地域视角的意味，通常不译为“回到东部”。
phrases:back-east-us.source: Old-timers used it to describe a man who had just arrived from one of the big cities back east
phrases:back-east-us.example: She grew up back east but now lives in Arizona.

phrases:clear-the-table-after-meal.title: clear the table：收拾餐桌
phrases:clear-the-table-after-meal.explanation: clear the table 表示饭后把盘子、杯子、餐具等从桌上收走，常用于家庭分工或餐后清理。
phrases:clear-the-table-after-meal.source: 改一下场景对话：不是你一句我一句，而是你直接把美国人常见的场景对话案例全展示给我
phrases:clear-the-table-after-meal.example: I’ll clear the table after breakfast.

phrases:come-on-in-invite-guest-inside.title: Come on in：快进来吧
phrases:come-on-in-invite-guest-inside.explanation: Come on in 是美式日常待客时很自然的进门邀请，语气亲切随意，比 Please enter 更生活化。
phrases:come-on-in-invite-guest-inside.example: Hey, come on in. Breakfast is almost ready.

phrases:continue-on.title: continue on：继续前行
phrases:continue-on.explanation: continue on 表示沿当前路线继续前行；on 强调向前延续，但在部分语境中只用 continue 也足够。
phrases:continue-on.source: A green light on a traffic signal means your car can continue on
phrases:continue-on.example: Continue on for another two miles.

phrases:dish-out-distribute-or-give.title: dish out something / dish something out
phrases:dish-out-distribute-or-give.explanation: dish out 的核心意思是把某物分发出去或给出去，既可以指食物，也常用于抽象事物，如建议、批评、惩罚或钱。
phrases:dish-out-distribute-or-give.source: Compare dish up and dish out
phrases:dish-out-distribute-or-give.example: The teacher dished out advice before the exam.

phrases:dish-up-serve-food-onto-plate.title: dish up something / dish something up
phrases:dish-up-serve-food-onto-plate.explanation: 短语动词 dish up 的字面来源是把食物盛到盘子或碟子里，常表示把饭菜分好、盛好给别人吃；宾语是代词时通常放在 dish 和 up 中间，如 dish it up。
phrases:dish-up-serve-food-onto-plate.source: Now, to dish up something means to put food on a dish for someone to eat
phrases:dish-up-serve-food-onto-plate.example: She dished up the soup and handed everyone a bowl.

phrases:get-the-plates-fetch-or-prepare.title: get the plates：去拿/准备盘子
phrases:get-the-plates-fetch-or-prepare.explanation: 日常口语里 get something 常表示去拿、取来或准备某物，不只是字面上的“得到”；get the plates 在餐桌场景中通常是把盘子拿过来或准备好。
phrases:get-the-plates-fetch-or-prepare.source: Sure. I'll dish up the eggs while you get the plates.
phrases:get-the-plates-fetch-or-prepare.example: Could you get the cups while I pour the tea?

phrases:go-out-with-romantic-dating.title: go out with someone：与某人约会
phrases:go-out-with-romantic-dating.explanation: go out with someone 在恋爱语境中表示与某人约会或谈恋爱，不只是一起外出；上下文决定其含义。
phrases:go-out-with-romantic-dating.source: A young man may suffer from the green-eyed monster if his girlfriend begins going out with someone else
phrases:go-out-with-romantic-dating.example: Is she going out with Daniel?

phrases:go-sailing-activity-collocation.title: go sailing：去帆船航行 / 去坐帆船
phrases:go-sailing-activity-collocation.explanation: go sailing 是 go + -ing 结构，表示去做某项休闲或运动活动。sailing 强调驾驶或乘帆船在水上活动，不等同于泛泛地说乘船 travel by boat。
phrases:go-sailing-activity-collocation.example: We might go sailing this weekend if the weather stays clear.

phrases:help-yourself-food-offer.title: help yourself：请自取/随便吃
phrases:help-yourself-food-offer.explanation: help yourself 常用于主人请客人或家人自己拿食物、饮料，语气轻松自然，意思是不用客气、自己取用。
phrases:help-yourself-food-offer.source: 改一下场景对话：不是你一句我一句，而是你直接把美国人常见的场景对话案例全展示给我
phrases:help-yourself-food-offer.example: Help yourself to some toast and coffee.

phrases:make-yourself-at-home.title: Make yourself at home：别拘束
phrases:make-yourself-at-home.explanation: Make yourself at home 用来让客人在家里放松自在，语气友好，常用于朋友来访或主人招待客人。
phrases:make-yourself-at-home.example: Make yourself at home. Coffee is on the counter.

phrases:old-timers.title: old-timers
phrases:old-timers.explanation: 指在某地生活很久、熟悉当地旧事和传统的人；语气较口语，不只是泛指老人。
phrases:old-timers.source: Old-timers used it to describe a man who had just arrived from one of the big cities back east
phrases:old-timers.example: The old-timers still remember when this road was unpaved.

phrases:review-common-collocations.title: review 的常见搭配
phrases:review-common-collocations.explanation: 高频搭配包括 review notes（复习笔记）、review a document（审查文件）、write a review（写评论）和 under review（正在审查中）。
phrases:review-common-collocations.example: The application is still under review.

phrases:set-the-table-arrange-place-sett.title: set the table：摆餐具
phrases:set-the-table-arrange-place-sett.explanation: set the table 表示吃饭前把盘子、杯子、刀叉或餐巾等摆好，不是设置桌子，而是准备餐桌。
phrases:set-the-table-arrange-place-sett.source: 改一下场景对话：不是你一句我一句，而是你直接把美国人常见的场景对话案例全展示给我
phrases:set-the-table-arrange-place-sett.example: Could you set the table while I dish up the eggs?

phrases:ten-minutes-of-rest.title: ten minutes of rest：十分钟的休息
phrases:ten-minutes-of-rest.explanation: of 结构把‘休息’当成一个整体名词短语，十分钟只是长度说明。这个说法比直接写 ten minutes rest 更完整，也常用于强调时间量。
phrases:ten-minutes-of-rest.example: He needed ten minutes of rest before continuing.

phrases:weather-report-forecast-informat.title: weather report：天气预报 / 天气报告
phrases:weather-report-forecast-informat.explanation: weather report 指电视、手机、网站或广播上的天气信息。出海、徒步、露营等户外活动前常说 check the weather report，表示先确认天气情况。
phrases:weather-report-forecast-informat.source: I’ll check the weather report before we go.
phrases:weather-report-forecast-informat.example: Check the weather report before you leave for the mountains.

phrases:what-a-lovely-day-for-activity.title: What a lovely day for...：多么适合……的好天气
phrases:what-a-lovely-day-for-activity.explanation: What a lovely day for + 名词 / -ing 用来感叹天气、时机或氛围很适合某个活动，比 It's a good day for... 更有感情色彩。
phrases:what-a-lovely-day-for-activity.source: What a lovely day for sailing.
phrases:what-a-lovely-day-for-activity.example: What a lovely day for a picnic.
